title: Sword Champions Simulator auto farm
script:
local farmActive = false

-- Function to handle firing RemoteEvent
local function fireRemoteEvent(tool)
    if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
        local script = tool.Handle:FindFirstChild("Script")
        if script and script:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvent") then
            for i = 1, 10 do
                script.RemoteEvent:FireServer()
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

-- Function to start or stop farming
local function toggleFarming()
    if farmActive then
        -- Stop farming
        farmActive = false
        print("Farming stopped.")
    else
        -- Start farming
        farmActive = true
        print("Farming started.")
        while farmActive do
            wait()
            local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            if not player then
                print("No LocalPlayer found.")
                return
            end
            local character = player.Character
            local backpack = player.Backpack

            -- Check tools in Character
            if character then
                local children = character:GetChildren()
                for i = 1, #children do
                    local tool = children[i]
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") and fireRemoteEvent(tool) then
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            -- Check tools in Backpack if not found in Character
            local backpackChildren = backpack:GetChildren()
            for i = 1, #backpackChildren do
                local tool = backpackChildren[i]
                if tool:IsA("Tool") and fireRemoteEvent(tool) then
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Listen for chat commands
game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
    local trimmedMessage = message:lower():gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1") -- Trim whitespace
    if trimmedMessage == "farm" then
        toggleFarming()
    elseif trimmedMessage == "unfarm" then
        farmActive = false
        print("Farming stopped.")
    end
end)

print("Script loaded successfully.")
